# Voxelite documentation

> Complete documentation, generated from the same source content and MCP catalog as the website.

---

Source: [https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/docs.md](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/docs.md)

# Documentation

A small world starts with a good first step.

Voxelite is a voxel editor with an MCP interface, a native Rust/GPUI workspace, and a browser build of the same editor. Create with an agent, work by hand, or move between both in a native session.

- [**Getting started ↗** Install the app, connect a host, and make your first model.](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/docs/getting-started.md)
- [**MCP tools ↗** The actual server catalog, with parameters and complete schemas.](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/docs/mcp.md)
- [**The .voxl format ↗** Portable projects, canonical JSON, and the rules on disk.](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/docs/format.md)
- [**Agent skills ↗** Reusable workflows for composition, palettes and visual review.](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/docs/skills.md)

## Choose your workspace

| Workspace      | Best for                                            | Agent connection                           |
| -------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| Native editor  | Hands-on editing and watching an agent work         | Local Unix socket through the stdio bridge |
| Browser editor | Trying the editor and downloading projects          | Not yet available                          |
| Headless MCP   | Scripted creation and CPU renders without a display | Stdio, with a project directory            |

These docs describe the implementation on the development branch. The [native Mac download](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/download/) isn't notarized yet; see the first-launch instructions. Linux builds and Chromium software graphics are verified; Safari/Firefox qualification remains pending.

Everything stays local. No account, cloud relay, or model-provider key is required by Voxelite, and your projects never leave your machine. This website uses cookie-free Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights for anonymous page-view and performance counts; nothing you build is collected. Your chosen agent host may have its own requirements.

---

Source: [https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/docs/getting-started.md](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/docs/getting-started.md)

# Getting started

Install Voxelite. Connect your agent. Make your first model.

- [Download for Mac ↘](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/download/)
- [Connect MCP ↘](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/docs/getting-started/#connect)

Just exploring? [Try the web editor](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/app/) on desktop.\
Keyboard & mouse required · 1024 × 640 minimum.

## Build from source

Install Rust with rustup, then run from a repository checkout. The pinned toolchain is Rust 1.99.1.

```sh
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
cargo build --locked --release \
  -p voxelite-app -p voxelite-mcp
./target/release/voxelite
```

[Download the native Mac app](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/download/) for macOS 13+ on Apple silicon, with installation and first-launch instructions. This build isn't notarized yet. Homebrew packages are not available yet. On macOS, install the Xcode command line tools (`xcode-select --install`) before building. This native target is wired through GPUI, but has not been built on this Linux machine. Linux native compilation and capture are verified with X11/Xvfb and Mesa software rendering.

Linux build and desktop dependencies (Debian / Ubuntu)

```sh
sudo apt-get install build-essential pkg-config clang libclang-dev \
  libxkbcommon-dev libxkbcommon-x11-dev libwayland-dev libvulkan-dev \
  libx11-xcb-dev libxcb1-dev libfontconfig-dev libasound2-dev libssl-dev \
  mesa-vulkan-drivers dbus-x11 xdg-desktop-portal xdg-desktop-portal-gtk
```

A display server and a desktop portal are needed for native windows and file dialogs. Headless MCP builds need no display or GPU:

```sh
cargo build --locked --release -p voxelite-mcp
cargo test -p voxelite-app --no-default-features
```

## Build the web editor and site

```sh
scripts/build-site.sh
python3 -m http.server 8090 --directory site --bind 127.0.0.1
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:8090`; the editor lives at `/app/`. The script builds the shared GPUI app for wasm, generates these docs from Rust, and copies `web/dist/` to `site/app/`. It installs the wasm target and matching wasm-bindgen CLI if needed. For site-only iteration after a web build, use `scripts/build-site.sh --skip-web`.

Use localhost or HTTPS for browser graphics. WebGPU is preferred and WebGL2 is the fallback. A query of `?backend=webgl` forces WebGL2. Save downloads a `.voxl`; download before reloading to preserve your edits. Browser MCP pairing and project recovery are not implemented.

## Make your first edit by hand

1.  Open the bundled Autumn Workshop. Right-drag to orbit; wheel to zoom; press F to frame.
2.  Select a visible, unlocked layer and a palette swatch. Press B to place on a face, E to erase, or P to paint.
3.  Use Ctrl/Cmd + Z to undo. Ctrl/Cmd + K opens command search.
4.  Choose File → Save As for your own `.voxl`. Export GLB or PNG through the File menu or command search.

## Connect your agent

Build `voxelite-mcp` first. Choose one of these modes; each standalone process owns its own in-memory documents.

### Headless: create and save independently

Use an existing directory as the file root. Substitute absolute paths for the placeholders below; they are examples, not commands to run unchanged.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "voxelite": {
      "command": "/absolute/path/to/voxelite-mcp",
      "args": ["--root", "/absolute/path/to/project"]
    }
  }
}
```

Merge that entry into `.mcp.json` for Claude Code or `.cursor/mcp.json` for Cursor. For Codex, merge this table into your trusted project's `.codex/config.toml` or user `~/.codex/config.toml`:

```toml
[mcp_servers.voxelite]
command = "/absolute/path/to/voxelite-mcp"
args = ["--root", "/absolute/path/to/project"]
```

Preserve existing settings. Reconnect the host, list tools, then call `voxelite_capabilities_get`. Expect API `voxelite.v1`, an epoch, CPU rendering, and open document IDs. Host launches are not verified in this headless environment. See the official [Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp), [Cursor](https://cursor.com/docs/mcp), and [Codex MCP](https://developers.openai.com/codex/mcp) documentation for host-specific setup.

### Native: work in the same document

```sh
./target/release/voxelite --session-socket /tmp/voxelite-session.sock
```

Configure the host's executable as above, replacing its arguments with `["--connect", "/tmp/voxelite-session.sock"]`. The socket path must not already exist. Or copy the configuration from Agent → Agent connection in the editor. Discover the existing model with capabilities; do not create a second document.

Watch committed calls in Session, pause new writes, and undo or edit by hand. The attached catalog excludes document create/open/save: the native editor owns file lifecycle. Save through the app. Browser sessions cannot attach yet.

## Your first model through MCP

In standalone mode, ask your connected agent:

> Build a 32 × 32 × 32 clay tower using one atomic box batch. Discover the epoch first. Inspect iso, front, right, and back PNGs, then save first-tower.voxl and export first-tower.glb. Use returned IDs and revisions for each write.

A minimal call sequence follows. These are tool argument objects, not full JSON-RPC messages. Replace placeholders with returned values, and generate a fresh UUID for each new mutation.

### 1\. Discover, then create

Call `voxelite_capabilities_get` with `{}`, then `voxelite_document_create`:

```json
{
  "name": "First tower",
  "bounds": {"min": [0, 0, 0], "max": [32, 32, 32]},
  "expected_epoch": "<returned epoch>",
  "operation_id": "<fresh UUID>"
}
```

### 2\. Batch the blockout

Call `voxelite_voxels_batch`. A new project has a Base layer and clay at slot 1.

```json
{
  "model_id": "<returned model_id>",
  "expected_epoch": "<returned epoch>",
  "expected_revision": "<current revision>",
  "operation_id": "<fresh UUID>",
  "label": "Block out tower",
  "operations": [
    {"kind": "box", "layer": "Base", "slot": 1,
     "region": {"min": [10, 0, 10], "max": [22, 2, 22]}},
    {"kind": "box", "layer": "Base", "slot": 1,
     "region": {"min": [13, 2, 13], "max": [19, 18, 19]}},
    {"kind": "box", "layer": "Base", "slot": 1,
     "region": {"min": [11, 18, 11], "max": [21, 20, 21]}}
  ]
}
```

### 3\. Inspect real pixels

Call `voxelite_render` and inspect the returned image block:

```json
{
  "model_id": "<returned model_id>",
  "views": ["iso", "front", "right", "back"],
  "width": 512, "height": 512,
  "image_mode": "contact_sheet",
  "revision": "<current revision>"
}
```

### 4\. Save the result

Call `voxelite_document_save` with the latest captured revision:

```json
{
  "model_id": "<returned model_id>",
  "expected_epoch": "<returned epoch>",
  "expected_revision": "<current revision>",
  "operation_id": "<fresh UUID>",
  "path": "first-tower.voxl"
}
```

Then call [voxelite\_export\_glb](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/docs/mcp/#voxelite_export_glb). Exports use `revision`, without mutation guards or operation IDs:

```json
{
  "model_id": "<returned model_id>",
  "revision": "<current revision>",
  "path": "first-tower.glb"
}
```

Save before disconnecting: edits and undo history live in memory. Existing export paths reject; choose a fresh output name.

## When a call fails

Check `isError` and the structured envelope's `ok` flag. On a revision conflict, read current state and rebase. On a lost response, retry only the identical request with the same operation ID in the same session. Never guess whether an edit committed. [Read the error guide](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/docs/mcp/#errors) before retrying.

---

Source: [https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/docs/mcp.md](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/docs/mcp.md)

# MCP tools

Coordinates in. Models out. Real visual feedback.

This reference is generated from the Rust server's live discovery catalog, API `voxelite.v1`. Download the [complete JSON catalog](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/assets/mcp-tools.json). Run `voxelite-mcp --schema` to inspect the catalog for your own build.

## Shared contract

*   Stdio uses one JSON-RPC message per line. Stdout contains protocol messages only; diagnostics go to stderr.
*   Supported protocol profiles: `2025-11-25` (initialize and initialized notification) and `2026-07-28` (per-request protocol metadata).
*   Discover the epoch with `voxelite_capabilities_get`. Writes use captured `expected_epoch`, a decimal-string `expected_revision` where required, and a fresh UUID `operation_id`.
*   Coordinate order is `[x, y, z]`, right-handed, Y up. Regions include `min` and exclude `max`. Slots are stable IDs, not display positions; zero means air only where the schema allows it.
*   Prefer layer UUIDs and stable slot numbers. Names must resolve uniquely. Unknown fields are rejected, including nested fields.
*   Atomic batches commit one undo entry or nothing. Content-edit results report revision, changed bounds/counts and history IDs. Check the result before updating your local state.
*   The same success JSON appears in `structuredContent` and the first text block. It contains `api_version`, `session_id`, `epoch`, `ok`, and `data` or `error`.

The attached native catalog omits `document_create`, `document_open`, and `document_save`. Use the native UI for file lifecycle. No screenshot-named tool or ellipsoid/cylinder tool is currently exposed: use `voxelite_render` for model images and explicit voxel batches for other shapes.

## Render feedback

Default views are iso/front/right/back at 512 × 512 each, returned as a 1024 × 1024 contact sheet. `image_mode` can return individual images, a sheet, or both. Images are actual PNG MCP image blocks, never a simulated preview.

At most six views, 1024 × 1024 per view and 4,194,304 combined view/sheet pixels are allowed, with a 12 MiB encoded response budget. Front looks from +Z, right from +X, top from +Y with −Z up. Explicit cameras and named views are mutually exclusive. Lower dimensions or view count after a budget error.

## Errors, retries and files

| Code                                    | Next step                                                                         |
| --------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `revision_conflict`, `epoch_conflict`   | Read the current model/session, rebase the intended edit, use a new operation ID. |
| `operation_id_reused`                   | Recover the original request. A retry must have identical tool, arguments and ID. |
| `layer_blocked`                         | Confirm the target layer; show or unlock it explicitly if intended.               |
| `history_conflict`                      | Read history and capture the exact current head/redo ID.                          |
| `invalid_argument`, `out_of_bounds`     | Correct the indicated field or half-open bounds.                                  |
| `limit_exceeded`                        | Reduce batch/page/render size. If receipts are exhausted, save and restart.       |
| `external_file_conflict`, `file_exists` | Preserve externally changed content; choose a new output path.                    |
| `path_outside_root`                     | Use a relative path within the configured file root. Parents must exist.          |
| `outcome_unknown`                       | Inspect the destination: rename may have succeeded before directory sync failed.  |

A domain error returns `isError: true` and `ok: false`, with a recovery hint. Transport success alone does not mean an edit succeeded. Cancellation does not undo an already committed edit. Exact retries replay successful receipts only within the current process.

File tools are confined to `--root`. New files are create-only. Saving over a previously opened/saved file requires its recorded hash to match. Save uses a sibling temporary file, sync and atomic installation. Export does not mark a document saved. Undo/retry state is session-local; comments and named versions persist in `.voxl`.

### voxelite\_capabilities\_get

Discover voxelite.v1, session epoch, limits, CPU renderer, exact palette presets and open model IDs. Start here; use returned epoch and revisions for edits.

| Argument | Required | Type / constraints |
| -------- | -------- | ------------------ |

Complete input schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {},
  "required": [],
  "type": "object"
}
```

Complete output schema

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "oneOf": [
    {
      "not": {
        "required": [
          "error"
        ]
      },
      "properties": {
        "ok": {
          "const": true
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "data"
      ]
    },
    {
      "not": {
        "required": [
          "data"
        ]
      },

          "const": false
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "error"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "properties": {
    "api_version": {
      "const": "voxelite.v1"
    },
    "data": {
      "additionalProperties": true,
      "properties": {
        "api_version": {
          "const": "voxelite.v1"
        },
        "documents": {
          "items": {
            "additionalProperties": true,
            "properties": {
              "bounds": {
                "additionalProperties": true,

                  "max": {
                    "items": {
                      "maximum": 32768,
                      "minimum": -32767,

                    },

                    "minItems": 3,
                    "type": "array"
                  },

                    "items": {
                      "maximum": 32767,
                      "minimum": -32768,

                    },

                },

                  "min",
                  "max"
                ],
                "type": "object"

                "maximum": 9223372036854775807,

            "minLength": 1,
            "type": "string"
          },

          "minItems": 1,

      "type": "string"
    },
    "error": {

          "maxLength": 80,
          "minLength": 1,
          "type": "string"

          "maximum": 255,
```

### voxelite\_comments\_add

Create a persistent voxel/region anchored thread. Author is always agent, never caller-supplied. Text is plain text, max 4096 UTF-8 bytes. Returns thread/message IDs; undoable and saved in .voxl.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `anchor`            | Yes      | See schema                                                                                                                           |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `layer`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 128. Layer UUID or unique exact name. Never inferred from UI selection.                                           |
| `message_id`        | Optional | string                                                                                                                               |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `text`              | Yes      | string; maxLength: 4096                                                                                                              |
| `thread_id`         | Optional | string                                                                                                                               |

Complete input schema

```json

      "type": "string"

    "model_id": {

      "type": "string"
    },
    "operation_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"

      "maxLength": 4096,
```

### voxelite\_comments\_list

List anchored threads including messages, agent/human roles, resolved state and anchor status. Optional state=open|resolved|all (default all). Thread and message pages default to 50, max 200. message\_offset applies per thread; bind pages with revision.

| Argument         | Required | Type / constraints                                                    |
| ---------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `limit`          | Optional | integer; minimum: 1; maximum: 200                                     |
| `message_limit`  | Optional | integer; minimum: 1; maximum: 200                                     |
| `message_offset` | Optional | integer; minimum: 0; maximum: 10000                                   |
| `model_id`       | Yes      | string                                                                |
| `offset`         | Optional | integer; minimum: 0; maximum: 1024                                    |
| `revision`       | Optional | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string. |
| `state`          | Optional | string; enum: \["open","resolved","all"\]                             |

Complete input schema

```json
{

      "maximum": 10000,
      "minimum": 0,
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "model_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "offset": {
      "maximum": 1024,
      "minimum": 0,
      "type": "integer"

      "type": "string"

    "state": {
      "enum": [
        "open",
        "resolved",
        "all"
      ],

  "type": "object"
}
```

### voxelite\_comments\_reopen

Reopen a resolved discussion; idempotent if already open. Preserves messages and anchor; undoable.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `thread_id`         | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |

### voxelite\_comments\_reply

Append an agent-attributed plain-text reply to a thread, resolved or open. One undoable edit; returns message ID.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `message_id`        | Optional | string                                                                                                                               |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `text`              | Yes      | string; maxLength: 4096                                                                                                              |
| `thread_id`         | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |

### voxelite\_comments\_resolve

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |

### voxelite\_document\_create

Create a revision-zero document and visible unlocked Base layer. Default bounds \[0,0,0\]..\[32,32,32\]. Returns model/layer IDs. Up to eight documents per session; never replaces an open model.

| Argument         | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                     |
| ---------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `bounds`         | Optional | object. Integer region: min inclusive, max exclusive. Each extent must be positive and at most 256 cells; checked at runtime.          |
| `expected_epoch` | Yes      | string                                                                                                                                 |
| `label`          | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime.   |
| `layer_id`       | Optional | string                                                                                                                                 |
| `model_id`       | Optional | string                                                                                                                                 |
| `name`           | Yes      | string; maxLength: 128. Nonempty text, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `operation_id`   | Yes      | string                                                                                                                                 |

Complete input schema


### voxelite\_document\_info

Read document identity, bounds, layers, counts, dirty state and current revision. Optional revision must equal the live revision; no UI state is used.

| Argument   | Required | Type / constraints                                                    |
| ---------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `model_id` | Yes      | string                                                                |
| `revision` | Optional | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string. |

### voxelite\_document\_open

Open a canonical .voxl file relative to the configured project root, preserving IDs, comments, versions and unknown metadata. Validation finishes before installation. Duplicate model IDs reject.

| Argument         | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ---------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `expected_epoch` | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `label`          | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `operation_id`   | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `path`           | Yes      | string; maxLength: 1024                                                                                                              |

Complete input schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "expected_epoch": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "label": {
      "description": "Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime.",
      "maxLength": 80,
      "minLength": 1,
      "pattern": "^[^\\u0000-\\u001f\\u007f-\\u009f]+$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "operation_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "path": {
      "maxLength": 1024,
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "expected_epoch",
    "operation_id",
    "path"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

### voxelite\_document\_save

Atomically save .voxl under the project root. New paths must not exist; overwriting the same opened/saved path checks its last SHA-256. Does not create an undo entry. Changes stay in memory until saved.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `path`              | Yes      | string; maxLength: 1024                                                                                                              |

Complete input schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "expected_epoch": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "expected_revision": {
      "description": "Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "label": {
      "description": "Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime.",
      "maxLength": 80,
      "minLength": 1,
      "pattern": "^[^\\u0000-\\u001f\\u007f-\\u009f]+$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "model_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "operation_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "path": {
      "maxLength": 1024,
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "expected_epoch",
    "operation_id",
    "model_id",
    "expected_revision",
    "path"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

### voxelite\_export\_glb

Export deterministic GLB of the highest visible layer at each occupied coordinate. Atomically write a new path under project root; existing paths reject. Returns size and SHA-256; document/history unchanged.

| Argument   | Required | Type / constraints                                                    |
| ---------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `model_id` | Yes      | string                                                                |
| `path`     | Yes      | string; maxLength: 1024                                               |
| `revision` | Optional | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string. |

Complete input schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",

      "type": "string"
    },
    "path": {
      "maxLength": 1024,
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "revision": {
      "description": "Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$",
      "type": "string"

  },
  "required": [
    "model_id",
    "path"
  ],
  "type": "object"
```

### voxelite\_export\_png

Render and atomically write one PNG under project root. Default contact sheet; for individual image use one view. Existing paths reject. Returns size, SHA-256 and camera metadata; document/history unchanged.

| Argument      | Required | Type / constraints                                                    |
| ------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `background`  | Optional | array; minItems: 4; maxItems: 4                                       |
| `camera`      | Optional | object                                                                |
| `height`      | Optional | integer; minimum: 1; maximum: 1024                                    |
| `image_mode`  | Optional | string; enum: \["contact\_sheet","individual"\]                       |
| `model_id`    | Yes      | string                                                                |
| `path`        | Yes      | string; maxLength: 1024                                               |
| `perspective` | Optional | boolean                                                               |
| `revision`    | Optional | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string. |
| `views`       | Optional | array; minItems: 1; maxItems: 6                                       |
| `width`       | Optional | integer; minimum: 1; maximum: 1024                                    |

Complete input schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "if": {
    "properties": {
      "image_mode": {
        "const": "individual"
      }
    },
    "required": [
      "image_mode"
    ]
  },
  "not": {
    "anyOf": [
      {
        "required": [
          "views"
        ]
      },
      {
        "required": [
          "perspective"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "required": [
      "camera"
    ]
  },
  "properties": {
    "background": {
      "items": {
        "maximum": 255,
        "minimum": 0,
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "maxItems": 4,
      "minItems": 4,
      "type": "array"
    },
    "camera": {
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "not": {
            "required": [
              "fov_y_degrees"
            ]
          },
          "properties": {
            "projection": {
              "const": "orthographic"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "ortho_height"
          ]
        },
        {
          "not": {
            "required": [
              "ortho_height"
            ]
          },
          "properties": {
            "projection": {
              "const": "perspective"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "fov_y_degrees"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "properties": {
        "eye": {
          "items": {
            "maximum": 1000000000.0,
            "minimum": -1000000000.0,
            "type": "number"
          },
          "maxItems": 3,
          "minItems": 3,
          "type": "array"
        },
        "fov_y_degrees": {
          "exclusiveMaximum": 179,
          "exclusiveMinimum": 1,
          "type": "number"
        },
        "ortho_height": {
          "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
          "maximum": 1000000000.0,
          "type": "number"
        },
        "projection": {
          "enum": [
            "orthographic",
            "perspective"
          ],
          "type": "string"
        },
        "target": {
          "items": {
            "maximum": 1000000000.0,
            "minimum": -1000000000.0,
            "type": "number"
          },
          "maxItems": 3,
          "minItems": 3,
          "type": "array"
        },
        "up": {
          "items": {
            "maximum": 1000000000.0,
            "minimum": -1000000000.0,
            "type": "number"
          },
          "maxItems": 3,
          "minItems": 3,
          "type": "array"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "eye",
        "target",
        "up",
        "projection"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    "height": {
      "maximum": 1024,
      "minimum": 1,
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "image_mode": {
      "enum": [
        "contact_sheet",
        "individual"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "model_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "path": {
      "maxLength": 1024,
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "perspective": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "revision": {
      "description": "Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "views": {
      "items": {
        "enum": [
          "iso",
          "front",
          "back",
          "left",
          "right",
          "top"
        ],
        "type": "string"
      },
      "maxItems": 6,
      "minItems": 1,
      "type": "array"
    },
    "width": {
      "maximum": 1024,
      "minimum": 1,
      "type": "integer"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "model_id",
    "path"
  ],
  "then": {
    "anyOf": [
      {
        "required": [
          "camera"
        ]
      },
      {
        "properties": {
          "views": {
            "maxItems": 1
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "views"
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

### voxelite\_history\_read

Read chronological applied history with agent origins, tool names, labels and change summaries. Includes exact undo/redo entry IDs. Default page 50, max 200; history is bounded and resets on reopen.

| Argument   | Required | Type / constraints                                                    |
| ---------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `limit`    | Optional | integer; minimum: 1; maximum: 200                                     |
| `model_id` | Yes      | string                                                                |
| `offset`   | Optional | integer; minimum: 0; maximum: 1048576                                 |
| `revision` | Optional | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string. |

Complete input schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "maximum": 200,
      "minimum": 1,
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "model_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "offset": {
      "maximum": 1048576,
      "minimum": 0,
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "revision": {
      "description": "Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "model_id"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

### voxelite\_history\_redo

Redo exactly the expected redo entry. Requires captured epoch/revision/entry\_id. A new edit clears the redo branch; stale IDs reject.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `entry_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |

Complete input schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "entry_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "expected_epoch": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "expected_revision": {
      "description": "Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "label": {
      "description": "Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime.",
      "maxLength": 80,
      "minLength": 1,
      "pattern": "^[^\\u0000-\\u001f\\u007f-\\u009f]+$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "model_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "operation_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "expected_epoch",
    "operation_id",
    "model_id",
    "expected_revision",
    "entry_id"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

### voxelite\_history\_undo

Undo exactly the expected top entry. Requires captured epoch/revision/entry\_id; intervening edits reject. Revision increases monotonically; original entry retains its agent attribution.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `entry_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |

Complete input schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "entry_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "expected_epoch": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "expected_revision": {
      "description": "Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "label": {
      "description": "Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime.",
      "maxLength": 80,
      "minLength": 1,
      "pattern": "^[^\\u0000-\\u001f\\u007f-\\u009f]+$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "model_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "operation_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "expected_epoch",
    "operation_id",
    "model_id",
    "expected_revision",
    "entry_id"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

### voxelite\_layers\_add

Insert an empty layer at bottom-to-top index (default append). Optional layer\_id supports deterministic references. Maximum 64 layers.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                                 |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                  |
| `index`             | Optional | integer; minimum: 0; maximum: 64                                                                                                       |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime.   |
| `layer_id`          | Optional | string                                                                                                                                 |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                                 |
| `name`              | Yes      | string; maxLength: 128. Nonempty text, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                                 |

Complete input schema

### voxelite\_layers\_list

| Argument   | Required | Type / constraints                                                    |
| ---------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `model_id` | Yes      | string                                                                |
| `revision` | Optional | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string. |

### voxelite\_layers\_lock

Set lock explicitly. Unlock in a separate operation before voxel editing; all mutations share the core lock rules and history.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `layer`             | Yes      | string; maxLength: 128. Layer UUID or unique exact name. Never inferred from UI selection.                                           |
| `locked`            | Yes      | boolean                                                                                                                              |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |

### voxelite\_layers\_remove

Delete one unlocked layer and its voxels as one undoable edit. Final-layer deletion rejects; anchored comments remain and may become orphaned.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `layer`             | Yes      | string; maxLength: 128. Layer UUID or unique exact name. Never inferred from UI selection.                                           |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |

### voxelite\_layers\_rename

Rename a layer without changing its stable ID. Duplicate names are allowed, but future name-based access must be unambiguous.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                                 |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                  |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime.   |
| `layer`             | Yes      | string; maxLength: 128. Layer UUID or unique exact name. Never inferred from UI selection.                                             |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                                 |
| `name`              | Yes      | string; maxLength: 128. Nonempty text, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                                 |

### voxelite\_layers\_reorder

Set an exact bottom-to-top permutation of all layer IDs/names. The highest visible layer wins at overlaps; omitted or duplicate layers reject.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `order`             | Yes      | array; minItems: 1; maxItems: 64                                                                                                     |

Complete input schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "expected_epoch": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "expected_revision": {
      "description": "Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "label": {
      "description": "Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime.",
      "maxLength": 80,
      "minLength": 1,
      "pattern": "^[^\\u0000-\\u001f\\u007f-\\u009f]+$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "model_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "operation_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "order": {
      "items": {
        "description": "Layer UUID or unique exact name. Never inferred from UI selection.",
        "maxLength": 128,
        "minLength": 1,
        "pattern": "^[^\\u0000-\\u001f\\u007f-\\u009f]+$",
        "type": "string"
      },
      "maxItems": 64,
      "minItems": 1,
      "type": "array"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "expected_epoch",
    "operation_id",
    "model_id",
    "expected_revision",
    "order"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

### voxelite\_layers\_visibility

Set visibility explicitly. Hidden cells stay stored and cannot be edited until made visible. Metadata changes are undoable.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `layer`             | Yes      | string; maxLength: 128. Layer UUID or unique exact name. Never inferred from UI selection.                                           |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `visible`           | Yes      | boolean                                                                                                                              |

Complete input schema

### voxelite\_palette\_apply\_preset

Append exact preset colors into unused slots without recoloring existing voxels. Returns source-to-new slot mapping. Rejects atomically if capacity would exceed 256; originals are immutable.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `preset`            | Yes      | string; enum: \["pico8","endesga32","sweetie16","grayscale","neutral","warm","vivid"\]                                               |

Complete input schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "expected_epoch": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "expected_revision": {
      "description": "Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "label": {
      "description": "Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime.",
      "maxLength": 80,
      "minLength": 1,
      "pattern": "^[^\\u0000-\\u001f\\u007f-\\u009f]+$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "model_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "operation_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "preset": {
      "enum": [
        "pico8",
        "endesga32",
        "sweetie16",
        "grayscale",
        "neutral",
        "warm",
        "vivid"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "expected_epoch",
    "operation_id",
    "model_id",
    "expected_revision",
    "preset"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

### voxelite\_palette\_export

Return palette as .hex or .gpl text in display order; GPL preserves representable names. Read-only, no filesystem side effects.

| Argument   | Required | Type / constraints                                                    |
| ---------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `format`   | Yes      | string; enum: \["hex","gpl"\]                                         |
| `model_id` | Yes      | string                                                                |
| `revision` | Optional | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string. |

Complete input schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "format": {
      "enum": [
        "hex",
        "gpl"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "model_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "revision": {
      "description": "Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "model_id",
    "format"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

### voxelite\_palette\_import

Append colors from bounded .hex or .gpl text into unused slots; no implicit geometry recoloring. Returns source-to-new mapping; malformed input or insufficient capacity leaves palette unchanged.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |
| `format`            | Yes      | string; enum: \["hex","gpl"\]                                                                                                        |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `text`              | Yes      | string; maxLength: 65536                                                                                                             |

Complete input schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "expected_epoch": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "expected_revision": {
      "description": "Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "format": {
      "enum": [
        "hex",
        "gpl"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "label": {
      "description": "Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime.",
      "maxLength": 80,
      "minLength": 1,
      "pattern": "^[^\\u0000-\\u001f\\u007f-\\u009f]+$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "model_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "operation_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "text": {
      "maxLength": 65536,
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "expected_epoch",
    "operation_id",
    "model_id",
    "expected_revision",
    "format",
    "text"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

### voxelite\_palette\_list

List stable palette slots, names, RGBA colors, display order and exact preset names. Slot 0 is reserved for air.

| Argument   | Required | Type / constraints                                                    |
| ---------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `model_id` | Yes      | string                                                                |
| `revision` | Optional | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string. |

Complete input schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "model_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "revision": {
      "description": "Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "model_id"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

### voxelite\_palette\_set\_slot

Add or replace stable slot 1..256 with opaque RGBA. Existing references change appearance, including locked layers. Omitted name creates an unnamed swatch. One undoable edit.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                                 |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                  |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime.   |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                                 |
| `name`              | Optional | string; maxLength: 128. Nonempty text, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                                 |
| `rgba`              | Yes      | array; minItems: 4; maxItems: 4. Opaque sRGB RGBA8; alpha must equal 255.                                                              |
| `slot`              | Yes      | integer; minimum: 1; maximum: 256                                                                                                      |

### voxelite\_query

Query bounds, counts or paged occupied voxels within a half-open region. view=layers (default) counts overlaps separately; composite uses highest visible layer. Optional layer restricts stored-layer queries. limit defaults 1000, max 10000. Use returned revision with next\_offset to prevent mixed pages.

| Argument   | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                            |
| ---------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`     | Yes      | string; enum: \["bounds","counts","voxels"\]                                                                                  |
| `layer`    | Optional | string; maxLength: 128. Layer UUID or unique exact name. Never inferred from UI selection.                                    |
| `limit`    | Optional | integer; minimum: 1; maximum: 10000                                                                                           |
| `model_id` | Yes      | string                                                                                                                        |
| `offset`   | Optional | integer; minimum: 0; maximum: 1048576                                                                                         |
| `region`   | Optional | object. Integer region: min inclusive, max exclusive. Each extent must be positive and at most 256 cells; checked at runtime. |
| `revision` | Optional | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                         |
| `view`     | Optional | string; enum: \["layers","composite"\]                                                                                        |

Complete input schema

### voxelite\_render

Render CPU PNG image content from one immutable revision. Default four views \[iso,front,right,back\] at 512², transparent background, orthographic, 2x AA, labeled contact sheet. Up to six views or one explicit camera; <=4,194,304 combined image/sheet pixels. image\_mode=contact\_sheet|individual|both. Returns camera metadata and hashes; no GPU/display required.

| Argument      | Required | Type / constraints                                                    |
| ------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `background`  | Optional | array; minItems: 4; maxItems: 4                                       |
| `camera`      | Optional | object                                                                |
| `height`      | Optional | integer; minimum: 1; maximum: 1024                                    |
| `image_mode`  | Optional | string; enum: \["contact\_sheet","individual","both"\]                |
| `model_id`    | Yes      | string                                                                |
| `perspective` | Optional | boolean                                                               |
| `revision`    | Optional | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string. |
| `views`       | Optional | array; minItems: 1; maxItems: 6                                       |
| `width`       | Optional | integer; minimum: 1; maximum: 1024                                    |

Complete input schema

```json

      {

        ]
      },
      {
        "required": [
          "perspective"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "required": [
      "camera"
    ]
  },
  "properties": {
    "background": {
      "items": {
        "maximum": 255,
        "minimum": 0,
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "maxItems": 4,
      "minItems": 4,
      "type": "array"
    },
    "camera": {
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "oneOf": [
```

### voxelite\_versions\_list

List named version IDs, names, parent IDs, origin and immutable content hashes. Persistent across save/open; independent of undo retention. Never includes full voxel snapshots.

| Argument   | Required | Type / constraints                                                    |
| ---------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `model_id` | Yes      | string                                                                |
| `revision` | Optional | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string. |

Complete input schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "model_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "revision": {
      "description": "Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "model_id"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

### voxelite\_versions\_restore

Restore named content as a new undoable edit, keeping the version library. Requires expected\_head\_id (null for empty history) in addition to revision/epoch. Core validates current locks before installation.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_head_id`  | Yes      | See schema                                                                                                                           |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `version_id`        | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |

Complete input schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "expected_epoch": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "expected_head_id": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "expected_revision": {
      "description": "Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "label": {
      "description": "Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime.",
      "maxLength": 80,
      "minLength": 1,
      "pattern": "^[^\\u0000-\\u001f\\u007f-\\u009f]+$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "model_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "operation_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "version_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "expected_epoch",
    "operation_id",
    "model_id",
    "expected_revision",
    "version_id",
    "expected_head_id"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

### voxelite\_versions\_save

Persist current content as a named immutable snapshot with agent attribution and content hash. Up to 64 versions, no recursive libraries. One undoable library edit; save document to retain across process restarts.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                                 |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                  |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime.   |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                                 |
| `name`              | Yes      | string; maxLength: 128. Nonempty text, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                                 |
| `parent_id`         | Optional | string                                                                                                                                 |
| `version_id`        | Optional | string                                                                                                                                 |

Complete input schema
