### voxelite\_voxels\_batch

Apply 1..256 ordered voxel operations atomically to one model: set, erase\_region, fill, box. Each operation names its own layer/mirror; nesting and I/O are forbidden. Later operations see earlier edits; any failure rolls back all; one revision and undo entry.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operations`        | Yes      | array; minItems: 1; maxItems: 256                                                                                                    |

### voxelite\_voxels\_box

Build an integer half-open solid box or one-cell shell (hollow=true). Default mode=place, hollow=false, mirror=none. slot required for place/paint, forbidden for erase. One atomic undo entry.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |
| `hollow`            | Optional | boolean                                                                                                                              |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `layer`             | Yes      | string; maxLength: 128. Layer UUID or unique exact name. Never inferred from UI selection.                                           |
| `mirror`            | Optional | object                                                                                                                               |
| `mode`              | Optional | string; enum: \["place","paint","erase"\]                                                                                            |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `region`            | Yes      | object. Integer region: min inclusive, max exclusive. Each extent must be positive and at most 256 cells; checked at runtime.        |
| `slot`              | Optional | See schema. Stable slot number or unique swatch name; zero is air for explicit writes only.                                          |

Complete input schema

```json

### voxelite\_voxels\_erase\_region

Erase occupied cells in min-inclusive/max-exclusive region. Mirror is explicit per call; omitted means none. Invalid/hidden/locked targets reject without partial edits.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `layer`             | Yes      | string; maxLength: 128. Layer UUID or unique exact name. Never inferred from UI selection.                                           |
| `mirror`            | Optional | object                                                                                                                               |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `region`            | Yes      | object. Integer region: min inclusive, max exclusive. Each extent must be positive and at most 256 cells; checked at runtime.        |

### voxelite\_voxels\_fill

Six-connected flood fill of the seed's slot, including air. Region defaults to document bounds; cap defaults to 1,048,576 visited cells. Cap exhaustion rejects atomically. Mirror never inherits UI state.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `cap`               | Optional | integer; minimum: 1; maximum: 1048576                                                                                                |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `layer`             | Yes      | string; maxLength: 128. Layer UUID or unique exact name. Never inferred from UI selection.                                           |
| `mirror`            | Optional | object                                                                                                                               |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `region`            | Optional | object. Integer region: min inclusive, max exclusive. Each extent must be positive and at most 256 cells; checked at runtime.        |
| `seed`              | Yes      | array; minItems: 3; maxItems: 3                                                                                                      |
| `slot`              | Yes      | See schema. Stable slot number or unique swatch name; zero is air for explicit writes only.                                          |

### voxelite\_voxels\_get

Read explicit integer coordinates on one layer, including air as slot 0. Returns values in request order. Out-of-bounds coordinates reject the entire read.

| Argument    | Required | Type / constraints                                                                         |
| ----------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `layer`     | Yes      | string; maxLength: 128. Layer UUID or unique exact name. Never inferred from UI selection. |
| `model_id`  | Yes      | string                                                                                     |
| `positions` | Yes      | array; minItems: 1; maxItems: 10000                                                        |
| `revision`  | Optional | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                      |

### voxelite\_voxels\_set

Atomically place or paint explicit cells, at most 65,536. Slot 0 erases; paint affects occupied cells only. Last duplicate wins before mirror expansion; mirror conflicts reject. Omitted mode=place, mirror=none. One undo entry.

| Argument            | Required | Type / constraints                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `expected_epoch`    | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `expected_revision` | Yes      | string. Captured monotonic revision, encoded as a decimal u64 string.                                                                |
| `label`             | Optional | string; maxLength: 80. Nonempty text, at most 80 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. The byte limit is also checked at runtime. |
| `layer`             | Yes      | string; maxLength: 128. Layer UUID or unique exact name. Never inferred from UI selection.                                           |
| `mirror`            | Optional | object                                                                                                                               |
| `mode`              | Optional | string; enum: \["place","paint"\]                                                                                                    |
| `model_id`          | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `operation_id`      | Yes      | string                                                                                                                               |
| `voxels`            | Yes      | array; minItems: 1; maxItems: 65536                                                                                                  |

Complete input schema

      "type": "string"

      "maxLength": 128,

      "type": "string"

            "maximum": 65536,
            "minimum": -65536,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "maxItems": 3,
          "minItems": 3,
          "type": "array"
        }
      },
      "required": [

        "plane2"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    "mode": {

        "paint"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "model_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "operation_id": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "voxels": {
      "items": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "properties": {
          "at": {
            "items": {
              "maximum": 32767,
              "minimum": -32768,
              "type": "integer"
            },
            "maxItems": 3,
            "minItems": 3,
            "type": "array"
          },
          "slot": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "maximum": 256,
                "minimum": 0,

              {
                "maxLength": 128,
                "minLength": 1,
                "type": "string"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Stable slot number or unique swatch name; zero is air for explicit writes only."
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "at",
          "slot"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "maxItems": 65536,
      "minItems": 1,
      "type": "array"
    }
  },

    "expected_epoch",
    "operation_id",
    "model_id",
    "expected_revision",
    "layer",
    "voxels"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

# The .voxl format

One project. One readable JSON file.

`.voxl` stores a complete portable project as UTF-8 JSON. This reference follows `voxelite-format` and the validated core model in this development build. Media type: `application/vnd.voxelite.project+json`. Current writer version: `{"major": 1, "minor": 0}`.

## Top-level structure

| Field               | Contract                                                                                            |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `format`            | Required literal `"voxelite"`.                                                                      |
| `version`           | Required `major` and `minor` unsigned 16-bit integers. Major must be 1. A newer minor is preserved. |
| `required_features` | Required array of strings. Only an empty array is currently supported.                              |
| `document`          | Required `id`, `name`, `bounds`.                                                                    |
| `palette`           | Required `slots` and `order`.                                                                       |
| `layers`            | Required array, bottom to top; 1–64 entries.                                                        |
| `comments`          | Optional thread array, omitted when empty.                                                          |
| `versions`          | Optional named snapshot array, omitted when empty.                                                  |
| `lineage`           | Optional source `document` and `version` UUIDs for an independent branch.                           |
| `view`              | Optional portable view metadata, excluded from the project semantic hash.                           |

## Coordinates and layers

Coordinates are integer `[x, y, z]` triples in a right-handed, Y-up space. A cell at `[x,y,z]` occupies a unit cube. `bounds.min` is inclusive and `bounds.max` exclusive. Each extent must be 1–256; cell coordinates must lie in `[-32768, 32768)`. The exclusive maximum may equal 32768.

Each layer has `id`, `name`, `visible`, `locked`, and `voxels`. A voxel row is `[x, y, z, slot]`. Omit air entirely: slot zero is invalid on disk. All rows must lie in the document bounds and reference existing palette slots. Duplicate coordinates within a layer reject; the same coordinate in different layers is valid. The highest visible occupied layer wins the composite. Hidden geometry is retained; lock state does not change rendering.

## Palette identity

A slot has `index` (1–256), `rgba` (four bytes, alpha exactly 255), and an optional `name`. There must be 1–256 slots, with unique indices. `order` is a full permutation of those indices and controls display order independently of identity. No translucent voxels are supported.

## Canonical bytes and hashes

*   Object keys sort lexicographically. Output uses two-space indentation, LF newlines, and one final newline.
*   Each voxel occupies one compact line, e.g. `[0, 0, 0, 1]`. Rows sort lexicographically by X, then Y, then Z.
*   Palette slots sort by index; comments and named versions sort by UUID. Layer order, palette display order and message order are meaningful and preserved.
*   UUIDs in validated ID fields use lowercase, hyphenated strings. Names are nonempty, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.
*   Outside `view`, numbers must use integer representation; fractional/exponent/negative-zero representations reject. Finite floating-point values are permitted inside `view`.
*   `Project::semantic_hash()` is SHA-256 of canonical file bytes with only the top-level `view` removed. Unknown optional metadata remains in that hash.

The project semantic hash differs from a named version's `content_hash`, which hashes the canonical core snapshot serialization. Use the Rust API to compute these hashes; do not substitute a generic pretty-printed JSON hash.

## Comments and named versions

A comment contains `id`, `anchor`, optional `layer`, `resolved`, and ordered `messages`. Anchors are `{"kind":"voxel","at":[x,y,z]}` or `{"kind":"region","min":[x,y,z],"max":[x,y,z]}`. Each message has `id`, `origin` (`human` or `agent`), plain-text `text`, and optional public `tool` ID. Hidden/orphaned state is derived, not stored; an anchor survives deleted geometry.

A named version contains `id`, `name`, optional `parent`, `origin`, `content_hash`, and a nonrecursive `snapshot`. Snapshots contain `name`, `bounds`, `palette`, `layers`, and optional `comments`. Hashes must match. Parents must exist in the same library, and cycles reject. Session IDs, revision counters, undo/redo entries and retry receipts are not serialized by the writer.

## Parser and resource limits

| Resource                                       | Limit                                                                               |
| ---------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Encoded file                                   | 128 MiB                                                                             |
| Live layer-voxels / allocated chunks           | 1,048,576 / 8,192; overlapping layers count separately                              |
| Decoded voxels across live and version content | 4,194,304                                                                           |
| Metadata excluding voxel arrays                | 8 MiB total; 4 MiB top-level comments, 4 MiB other metadata                         |
| JSON nesting / optional metadata nesting       | 32 / 16                                                                             |
| Comment threads / messages                     | 1,024 / 10,000 per snapshot; each message 1–8,192 UTF-8 bytes; 4 MiB comment budget |
| Named versions                                 | 64; aggregate canonical snapshot bytes ≤64 MiB                                      |

Duplicate object keys reject at every level. Parsing validates all layers and snapshots, including hidden content. Unknown major versions and nonempty required-feature lists fail without installing the document. Limits may reject a file before any model becomes available.

## Forward compatibility

Bounded unknown optional fields are preserved as inert data and merged by stable IDs or palette indices, not array position. Optional extension values accept strings, booleans, null, signed 64-bit integers, arrays and objects within depth limits. They are never interpreted as executable code or remote resources. Known fields always come from current validated content.

## A complete example

[Download a valid one-voxel project](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/assets/minimal.voxl). The site crate tests this fixture against the actual format reader and verifies canonical byte equality.

```json
{
  "document": {
    "bounds": {"max": [16, 16, 16], "min": [0, 0, 0]},
    "id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
    "name": "One voxel"
  },
  "format": "voxelite",
  "layers": [{
    "id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002",
    "locked": false, "name": "Base", "visible": true,
    "voxels": [[0, 0, 0, 1]]
  }],
  "palette": {
    "order": [1],
    "slots": [{"index": 1, "name": "clay", "rgba": [180, 140, 100, 255]}]
  },
  "required_features": [],
  "version": {"major": 1, "minor": 0}
}
```

This displayed example is compacted for readability. The downloadable file uses canonical whitespace. Open it in the editor or with `voxelite_document_open` to validate it; the app preserves the existing document if an open fails.

Source: [https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/docs/skills.md](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/docs/skills.md)

# Agent skills

Teach the workflow once. Keep the creative loop moving.

These portable skills teach agents how to use the implemented Voxelite MCP tools. They cover atomic edits, palette choices, primitive composition, real image inspection and recovery from conflicts.

- [**Voxel art workflow ↗** Discover, compose, inspect, refine and save.](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/assets/skills/voxelite-workflow/SKILL.md)
- [**Palettes ↗** Material roles, exact presets and stable slot mappings.](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/assets/skills/voxelite-palettes/SKILL.md)
- [**Primitive shapes ↗** Boxes, mirrored masses and computed curved forms.](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/assets/skills/voxelite-primitives/SKILL.md)
- [**Render review ↗** Four real views, concrete repairs and consistent evidence.](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/assets/skills/voxelite-render-review/SKILL.md)

## Install in your host

[Download all four skills](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/assets/voxelite-skills.zip), or copy their directories from the repository's `skills/` folder. [Full install, update and removal notes](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/assets/skills/README.md).

| Host        | Location                                                                                                                          |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Claude Code | `~/.claude/skills/` or project `.claude/skills/`                                                                                  |
| Cursor      | `.cursor/skills/` or personal `~/.cursor/skills/`; scoped rules can point to source skills                                        |
| Codex       | Current docs: `.agents/skills/` or `~/.agents/skills/`. Some clients expose `~/.codex/skills/`; verify discovery for your client. |

Codex can also read these files through a scoped project `AGENTS.md` instruction. Installing a skill does not configure MCP: [connect the server separately](https://voxelite.worldwidewebb.co/docs/getting-started/#connect). No plugin marketplace package is included here.

Host guidance: [Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills), [Cursor](https://cursor.com/docs/skills), [Codex skills](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/build-skills), and [AGENTS.md](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/agent-configuration/agents-md). Host application launches remain untested in this environment.

## Give it a first brief

> Use the Voxelite workflow to build a warm brass lantern within 32 × 32 × 32 cells. Save a blockout version, inspect iso/front/right/back renders, repair the handle silhouette, then save .voxl and GLB.

The render-review skill uses `voxelite_render` for real PNG feedback. There is no screenshot-named MCP tool in this build. Primitive guidance also stays within today's catalog: boxes and explicit voxel batches, without invented cylinder or ellipsoid calls.

## Know when it worked

The agent should report the model revision, views it actually inspected, and saved output paths. A successful render call is not visual inspection, and exporting an image is not saving a project. These distinctions are part of every workflow.
